Target processes regulated by Cullin3 in response to salt stress based on the proteomic analysis

Target processes regulated by Cullin3 in response to salt stress based on the proteomic analysis. Under salt stress, Cullin3 potentially regulates multiple metabolic pathways including up-regulated glutathione metabolism and carbon metabolism (red triangle) and down-regulated photosynthesis and translation (green triangle), as suggested by the over-representation analysis of the significant salt-responsive differentially expressed proteins (DEPs). The pathways are shown together with their respective modulated proteins
